eyebrowInstitution: University of Engineering and Management, Kolkata
headline: Building a community for safer and more aligned AI.
introduction: UEMK ASIA brings together students, faculty, and researchers interested in understanding and improving AI safety and alignment.
mission: Our mission is to make space for careful learning, open discussion, and collaborative research on the safety and alignment of AI systems.
about: UEMK ASIA is an emerging initiative at the University of Engineering & Management, Kolkata. We welcome people who are curious about AI safety, whether they are just getting started or already working in the field.
